slots.image_prompt: A dark futuristic tech-style cover background with a dense swarm of luminous sky-blue (#2196F3) particles streaming from the left side and converging rightward into an intricate open-source network node constellation. Glowing connections form a hexagonal mesh pattern across the right half. Deep navy-black backdrop with subtle cyan (#00BCD4) rim lighting. Thin geometric grid lines faintly visible in the background. Cinematic depth of field, volumetric light haze, high-contrast neon glow against darkness. Wide aspect, immersive atmosphere of distributed collaboration and digital infrastructure.

A dark tech-style section divider background featuring horizontal bands of flowing sky-blue (#2196F3) gradient light bands sweeping diagonally across the frame, interlaced with a faint isometric geometric grid pattern. Subtle cyan (#00BCD4) accent light streaks punctuate the composition. Deep charcoal base with soft ambient glow. Minimal, atmospheric, cinematic depth. Suggests layered data streams and structured information flow. No text, no figures, purely ambient decorative environment for a chapter heading overlay.

A horizontal luminous gradient spectrum bar stretching across the frame, transitioning smoothly from bright sky-blue (#2196F3) on the far left through mid-tone cyan (#00BCD4) at the center to muted slate-gray (#607D8B) on the far right. The bar is flanked by soft radial glows and delicate concentric ring motifs above and below, suggesting zones of intensity. Five evenly spaced translucent lens flare nodes sit along the spectrum, each emitting a faint vertical beam of light. Dark navy background, tech-infographic aesthetic, minimalist and clean. No text or labels.

A dark tech-style abstract quadrant diagram visualized as a glowing coordinate cross splitting the frame into four zones. The horizontal and vertical axes are rendered as bright sky-blue (#2196F3) neon lines with a soft cyan (#00BCD4) halo. Each quadrant pulses with a distinct energy pattern — the top-left shows tight concentric circles, top-right radiating beams, bottom-left scattered dots, bottom-right a smooth flowing wave. Subtle geometric wireframe elements float in each zone. Deep charcoal background, high-contrast neon glow, futuristic data-viz aesthetic. No text or numbers.

A dark tech-style ambient background where thousands of randomly scattered luminous points on the left gradually align and flow rightward into a perfectly ordered blue grid lattice. The transition zone shows points caught mid-transformation, some still drifting, others snapping into alignment. Sky-blue (#2196F3) glow with cyan (#00BCD4) highlights. Deep navy-black backdrop with subtle volumetric haze. The visual evokes emergence of order from entropy, inspired by chaos theory. Cinematic depth, wide framing, no text or figures.

A dark tech-style abstract representation of a software supply chain as an interconnected node network. A central spine of sky-blue (#2196F3) glowing nodes connected by luminous bidirectional arrows fans out into branching dependency sub-networks. A few isolated nodes pulse with an ominous deep-red glow, indicating vulnerability points, while the majority radiate safe blue light. Thin data-stream lines weave between clusters. Deep navy background with volumetric depth, futuristic cybersecurity aesthetic. No text, labels, or numbers.

A dark tech-style section divider visual featuring a stack of floating hardcover books on the left side, each spine glowing with sky-blue (#2196F3) light. From the top book, a vertical pillar of luminous cyan (#00BCD4) energy beams upward, dispersing into fine particle trails. The books emit a soft halo against the deep charcoal background. Subtle geometric light grid faintly visible in the distance. Cinematic, atmospheric, symbolic of knowledge dissemination and open-source enlightenment. No text on book spines.

A dark tech-style ambient visual of a virtual bookshelf rendered as a glowing horizontal array of uniformly-spaced book-card silhouettes floating in mid-air. Each card emits a soft sky-blue (#2196F3) backlight, with subtle cyan (#00BCD4) accent highlights along the edges. A diffuse blue glow bathes the entire scene from behind. Deep navy-black background with a faint isometric grid pattern. The composition evokes a curated digital library, minimalist and serene. No visible text or titles on the cards.

A dark tech-style closing slide background with a radiant burst of sky-blue (#2196F3) light beams fanning outward from a glowing central point near the middle of the frame. Surrounding the core, a loose constellation of smaller luminous dots — like distant contributor nodes — is scattered across the deep navy-black field, each emitting a faint cyan (#00BCD4) halo. Volumetric haze fills the space between beams. The overall mood is warm, grateful, and expansive — suggesting a global community reaching outward. No text or figures.
